findings: Root cause of UI thread freezes: buildVolumeFromDicomBuffers and buildVolumeFromMultiFrameDicom executed 131M calibration loops on the UI thread without yielding, starving the browser event loop for 3-8 seconds on 500-slice CBCT scans.

Progressive LOD: 2x downsampling in X, Y, and Z reduces voxel count by 8x (16.3M vs 131M voxels), generating a valid CbctVoxelVolume in < 50ms, allowing doctors to view MPR planes instantly while streaming ingestion completes.
Worker Bridge Transferables: Returning Int16Array.buffer via Transferable objects eliminates 200MB+ memory cloning and garbage collection pressure in V8.
Cooperative Scheduling: Periodic yieldToEventLoop() every 16 slices guarantees the browser can dispatch DOM events, paint progress indicators, and respond to user interactions.
